name: TrakSpool Firmware
changes: Fixed BLE provisioning failing after credentials were entered, and the network list coming up empty on every attempt after the first — the device's Wi-Fi auto-join was competing with the provisioning manager for the radio
Fixed the OLED network scan reporting "Scan failed" instantly when the Wi-Fi radio had been initialised but not actually started
Wi-Fi auto-join now makes 10 attempts instead of 3 before giving up, so a brief router outage no longer disables Wi-Fi until the device is power-cycled
